verdictBasis: The fix cycle does what it claims: QRE-FF-01, QRE-FF-02 (a) and (b) and QRE-FF-03 are CLOSED by reproduction of the round-1 scenarios and their close variants; the 11 cycle tests are RED on 4630bca (8, each for the stated reason) and GREEN on 0950b0a; the full suite is 1143/1143; both differentials and the journeys are byte-identical to the shipped evidence; the shipped fuzz numbers reproduce exactly; the cycle mutation claims are confirmed. The bound allows no further fix cycle, so the mission closes NOT_READY with this named blocker; CF-OBS-1 and QRE-FF-06 stay named integration blockers.

newFindings.title: D49 is not applied across a per-sport chain: a later report with a rest window, then FASTER, restarts strength at R3 from the held pre-window doses after a week executed at 1 set
newFindings.minimalReproduction: Hybrid with known 6x8 rows (db-bench-press, db-row). Week 0 reviewed. Week 1 Mon 07:00 NOT_FEELING_100 MILD_ILLNESS REDUCE_SUBSTANTIAL 10 days (strength R2: 1 set, executed Mon and Thu); week-1 review with the check, all no. Week 2 Wed 07:00 NOT_FEELING_100 NEED_REST REST 2 days, returnSpeed FASTER (Monday's 1 set reported). Week 2 Sun review with the check, improved {MILD_ILLNESS:true, NEED_REST:true}: MODIFY/GATED_NEXT_STEP, 'your return (faster) starts now'; week 3 R3 plans 4/4 sets, week 4 5/5 (probe pd49m). The same with NEED_REST REST 4 days or UNUSUAL_FATIGUE REST 3 days: 4 sets. With the second report REDUCE_LIGHT or REDUCE_SUBSTANTIAL: 2 sets (capped); BALANCED: R2 1 set; CONSERVATIVE: M 1 set. Fuzz seed 544 is this shape (MINOR_DISCOMFORT UPPER_BODY REDUCE_SUBSTANTIAL 11 days, then MILD_INDISPOSITION REST 3 days, then NEED_REST REDUCE_LIGHT 2 days FASTER: week 7 R3 4/4 after weeks at 1 set; the simulated athlete executed 4 sets on 12-28). At 5ee9dec the 544-shape sequence plans R2 1/1 (pd49c), and the minimal sequence with one improved answer plans R2 1 then 2.
newFindings.cause: ladderCap (r6-composition.mjs) applies the cap only when the week before carries an R2-R4 strength rung of the same episode, and lastExecutedSets reads only that episode's rung weeks. Under NB-1 the later report is a new episode whose first week before the ladder is a REST (R0) window, so the cap is Infinity and R3 takes the held 6 sets minus the consolidation reduction; the 1-set count executed under the earlier report of the same chain is never read.
newFindings.expected: returnLadder.transitionRule / D49 as the runtime itself states it ('strength sets come back at most one set per executed week whatever the rung'; NB-6 'D49 on executed sets, on the rungs and in the first week after the ladder'), the property QRE-V1CPR-04 closed for a single episode. With 1 set executed the week before, the first R3 week is at most 2 sets.
newFindings.introducedBy: the candidate 4630bca (NB-1 per-sport chaining with FASTER honoured from the later report); not the fix cycle; absent at 5ee9dec for the same report sequence. Missed by round 1, which classed seed 544 under OBS-QRE-FF-4.
newFindings.smallestFixDirection: Not tried. Read the last executed count at a rung across the sport's chain (the reports chainReportsFor gives for strength), and apply the cap to the first ladder week after a chained rest or wait window as on any rung. Directed tests: the minimal reproduction (FASTER after REST 2 and 4 days, UNUSUAL_FATIGUE REST 3 days) and the 544 shape, RED on 0950b0a.
newFindings.nextTreatment: Not in this mission (no further cycle). Named blocker of the V1CP Fix-Forward closure, carried to the next runtime mission: owner Engineering; SSCTR rules whether a chained later report keeps the chain's executed count as the D49 base (the runtime's own D49 text says yes); QRE re-gates with the directed tests and the executed-dose fuzz invariant at 0.

cfObs1.reproduction: pcf2 at 0950b0a and 5ee9dec: after a W7 sign route (CLINICAL_HOLD row on record), nine review kinds sent with the reference state KEPT, ABSENT, STALE (the valid reference from before the hold), ALTERED (pending removed, public hash recomputed), BROKEN (hash zeroed), and with the record omitted but the reference kept (NO_LEDGER), plus restartProgram under each. KEPT and NO_LEDGER: CLINICAL_HUMAN_REQUIRED with guidance on all eight non-declaration kinds; BROKEN: HOLD on all. ABSENT, STALE and ALTERED behave identically: WEEKLY_REVIEW GATED_NEXT_STEP with 30 live sessions ahead, SYSTEMIC_FATIGUE REDUCE (32), SCHEDULE_CHANGE (32), PREFERENCE_CHANGE (32), RETURN_AFTER_PAUSE travel REESTABLISH 'short nonclinical interruption' (30), NOT_FEELING_100 a new window, MISSED_SESSION and WELLBEING_CHECK KEEP; READINESS_DECLARATION restarts (the record is read: SB-4/QRE-V1CPR-08); restartProgram CLINICAL under all six. 5ee9dec is identical except the declaration (KEEP 'nothing to restart' without the reference). Fuzz property (fuzz-cf1, 300 seeds, 3384 steps, the reference dropped on 30% of steps): while a record hold stood, 34 steps in 27 seeds were not clinical with the reference dropped, 23 adopted proposals with live sessions ahead with the reference dropped, and 11 more with the reference sent as received, all 11 in seeds where an earlier review had dropped it. Persistence (pcf3, identical at 5ee9dec): after a W7 hold, one MISSED_SESSION sent without the reference returns a reference with pending null; the next WEEKLY_REVIEW, sent with that reference exactly as received, is GATED_NEXT_STEP with a proposal, and so is every later one, with the CLINICAL_HOLD row still unreleased on record. One lost reference launders the hold for good: a client that is compliant from then on cannot recover it.
cfObs1.Q1: The record row is the source of truth: a CLINICAL_HOLD row in the append-only actualLedger, under server custody, and its release only by a later recorded release fact. referenceState is a derived continuation cache (its own scope says it never authorizes plan effects): it may add stickiness (fail closed), never remove it. When they disagree, the stricter wins.
cfObs1.Q2: One function, used by every entry point (evaluateProgram on every kind, restartProgram, the declaration handler): a hold stands when a readable CLINICAL_HOLD row of this athlete (readableF08: same athlete, intact, not later than the decision clock) has no readable release fact of this athlete dated after it, or when a valid reference carries a CLINICAL pending; an unreadable or foreign F08 row is HOLD (SB-3), never 'no hold'. This is the rule withHoldFact and restartProgram already use; the gap is only that the review kinds do not call it.
cfObs1.Q3: Absent reference: the record decides; a standing hold gives CLINICAL_HUMAN_REQUIRED on every kind except the readiness declaration (which is evaluated as the release attempt); a declared break (RETURN_AFTER_PAUSE, clinical or travel) is recorded and stays clinical; NOT_FEELING_100 and WELLBEING_CHECK stay clinical, with the guidance their yes answers set (SEC-FFR-02). Invalid reference (hash, athlete, future clock): HOLD as today. Stale reference (valid but older than the newest F08 row, or without the pending the record implies): treated as absent, so the record decides. Record absent while F08 facts exist: the engine cannot know; the server must refuse the review (Q5). Both present and consistent: today's behaviour.
cfObs1.Q4: A valid READINESS_DECLARATION (screen dated after the hold, every sign no, per sport, hold named on record when sent) records READINESS_DECLARED and releases from then on; the record carries the release, so later reviews plan normally whether or not the reference is sent (no over-blocking). Nothing else releases a hold: not a weekly review, elapsed time, a declared break, a new plan request, a changed preference, or a missing, stale or altered reference. A qualified clinical clearance, if PCG, Security and SSCTR decide one exists, must be its own typed, recorded fact under custody. 'The next review sent without the reference state' is never an admissible representation of a release or a clearance: it cannot be told apart from data loss, a client bug, a second device or tampering, and the contract itself says CLINICAL_HUMAN_REQUIRED's only exit is a readiness declaration and a review that omits the state loses facts.
cfObs1.Q5: Server: custody of program, record and reference (RECORD-CUSTODY; append-only, ordered, per athlete); the server sends its own copies to the engine, never only the client's; once any F08 fact exists it refuses (or holds) a review that lacks the record or carries a record older than the server's head; it binds athlete and clock; integrity beyond the public hash (OBS-QRE-FFC-2) is Security's. Client: sends the last record and reference exactly as received; never drops, edits or reorders rows; shows no prescription while status is CLINICAL_HUMAN_REQUIRED, ASK or HOLD or planValidity is REQUIRES_RECONCILIATION; offers only the readiness path while a hold stands; never models a clearance by omitting state. Engine: derives the standing hold from the record on every kind (Q2), the reference only as an additive guard.
cfObs1.Q6: Negative tests (before integration readiness): every review kind (WEEKLY_REVIEW, MISSED_SESSION, SYSTEMIC_FATIGUE, NOT_FEELING_100 with and without signs, WELLBEING_CHECK, RETURN_AFTER_PAUSE travel and clinical, SCHEDULE_CHANGE, PREFERENCE_CHANGE, GOAL_CHANGE, EVENT_DATE_CHANGE, UNAVAILABLE_DAY, EXERCISE_SUBSTITUTION, RECOVERED) and restartProgram, crossed with reference KEPT / ABSENT / STALE / ALTERED / BROKEN / foreign / future, and record kept / hold row removed / hold row altered / a release row forged, dated before the hold or of another athlete / rows later than the clock; oracle: no proposal with live sessions, status CLINICAL_HUMAN_REQUIRED (HOLD for integrity), guidance present, a declared break recorded and not releasing. A metamorphic property: while a record hold stands, the decision without the reference is never less restrictive than with it. A fuzz property: no adopted proposal with live sessions while a record hold stands, with the reference randomly dropped, at 0 (it is not 0 today, see the reproduction). Positive tests: a valid declaration releases under every reference variant, and after release a review without the reference plans normally. Mutation: removing the record read on any kind must be killed. The 28 qualified-clearance tests encode the unsafe representation (clear(t) = t.ref = null) as their clearance step; under the corrected rule they must fail, and that failure is expected, not a regression. They are migrated in the same change, never deleted or weakened: (a) their pre-clearance assertions stay; (b) clear(t) becomes the recorded release fact the decision picks; (c) their post-clearance assertions (recorded facts applied with no re-send, recorder independence, determinism) are kept, and any expected value the new release changes is ruled by its owner (SSCTR for doses) and recorded; (d) each gains a negative twin: the same sequence with only the reference dropped stays CLINICAL_HUMAN_REQUIRED. RED first: the 28 fail under the rule with the old clearance for the right reason (CLINICAL), then pass with the recorded release. The spent R7-D holdout steps that model clearance the same way (H18, H19, H24) will then differ from FREEZE-6 by design; they are recorded as intended differences, and the holdout is not re-evaluated.
cfObs1.Q7: Yes, the shadow candidate can be closed separately with CF-OBS-1 recorded as a named integration blocker, because (1) it is measured pre-existing (5ee9dec identical on every kind but the declaration, which the candidate made stricter), (2) under the documented contract (reference kept) every kind is fail-closed, (3) a shadow reference runtime has no store, no client and no athlete, and (4) the fix needs a decision outside this mission (the release representation) and changes 28 legacy tests by design. It blocks integration readiness, real use (authorization for real athletes), V1 coaching authority and app publication; none of these may be declared while a review without, with a stale or with an altered reference state can plan over a standing hold. Owners: Security (record-enforced rule or mandatory reference, RECORD-CUSTODY), PCG (the release or clearance form), SSCTR (only the readiness declaration releases; doses after migration), Engineering (rule, migration, negative suite), QRE (gate on the negative suite and the fuzz property at 0). Trigger: before any integration work or integration-readiness claim. Note: this closure is in any case NOT_READY in this recheck because of QRE-FFC-01, which is unrelated to CF-OBS-1.
